units.text: INT. HOSPITAL MRI SUITE - NIGHT
A hum like a held note.
The scanner sits dark.
A patient's gurney is parked beside it, empty.
Rain taps a high window.
DR. THEODORE ABIODUN, 50s, rubs his eyes at the control desk.
BERNADETTE KOWALSKI, 70s, in a hospital gown and slippers, sits on the edge of a plastic chair.
He notices her only when he turns.
He rises.
She does not.
Mrs. Kowalski. You're supposed to be upstairs.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: I couldn't sleep.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: You could have rung for a nurse.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: They told me the scan was clean.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: It is.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: Then why are you here at one in the morning?
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: I like the quiet.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: Doctors don't like quiet. They like numbers.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: He pulls a stool close and sits.
Neither speaks for a moment.
Your daughter called.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: She calls every day.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: She asked me to check you were comfortable.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: She asked you to lie to me.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: Mrs. Kowalski.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: Dr. Abiodun. Do I look like a woman who needs to be handled?
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: He considers this.
He lifts a folder from the desk and sets it in her lap.
Fourteen months. Perhaps sixteen. I should have said so this afternoon.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: You were kind enough not to.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: I was a coward.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: You were both. It's allowed.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: She opens the folder, glances at the images, and closes it.
Her hands rest on top of it, perfectly still.
My husband went in eleven weeks. Fourteen months is a luxury.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: I'm sorry.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: Don't be. Sit with me a while.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: I will.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: Tell me about the quiet.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: It's mostly the machine.
units.name: THEODORE

units.text: Then listen to it with me.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: The hum swells softly.
They sit side by side, two figures in the blue half-light, as the rain eases.
